record.reason: Machine fault diagnosis from vibration requires learning from scarce labelled fault recordings while meeting the computational constraints of edge devices for local inference. We introduce DualRes, a compact oscillatory state-space model that combines two complementary spectral views of vibration, capturing rapid changes and fine frequency structure.
